text:
21 hours ago 🏛️ Woodford Co. Board of Health: Sept. 29 meeting topics
The Woodford County Board of Health will meet on Tuesday, September 29, 2026 at 5:30 p.m. in the Woodford County Board Room, 1837 S Main St., Eureka, IL 61530 . The public can speak during the public input period and may also attend online by Zoom using Meeting ID 837 2052 0164 and Passcode 907550 .
After roll call and approval of the July 22, 2026 minutes, the Board will hear:
Environmental Health , Clinical , and Administrator reports Financial updates, including the Third Party Billing Report and monthly financials, plus bills paid between meetings A presentation on the “Rural Health Transformation Program: Community Access and Rural Engagement (CARE) on the Move Illinois Grant” through the Illinois Primary Healthcare Association Under Old Business , they may take action on:
Setting Environmental Health office hours, including a new 40-hour schedule An addendum to the Board of Health By-Laws An Employee Health Policy Under New Business , they may act on:
A new clinical service: “Venipuncture for send-out labs” Updates to the Employee Policy Manual The 2027 Board of Health meeting schedule An executive session under 5 ILCS 120/2(c)(1) is planned to discuss specific employees, with any public votes to follow. The 2026 schedule also adds an extra meeting on November 18 .
More Info: https://www.woodford-county.org/AgendaCenter/ViewF...
